cleaning_rules.description: Trim spaces and treat placeholder text (N/A, null, -) as missing
Remove exact duplicate rows (first copy kept)
Remove rows missing a required value (order_id, order_date, quantity, unit_price)
Remove rows with an unreadable or impossible order_date
Remove rows where quantity is not a whole number above zero
Remove rows where unit_price is not a number or is negative
Make category spellings consistent (most common spelling kept)
Fill missing optional text values with "Unknown"
